methodology_amendments.reason: The first raw runs exposed label leakage: generated PR statistics matched acknowledgment phrases (including CI posted through a human maintainer account), issue activity later in the firing hour could label an earlier firing, and an explicit downstream-distributor closure was read as a fix. V3 grades only issue acknowledgments, excludes bots, restricts candidate issue activity to timestamps at or before the firing, and recognizes the disclosed downstream-build negative phrase. Detector outputs and agent fixtures were unchanged.
